fields: L4 Beijing / Chinese New Year (tricycle; Shichahai hutong → Chang'an Avenue → Summer Palace). Same item fields as L3 v3.1. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = Lantern Riddle Stand 灯谜摊 questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = Chang'an Avenue fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Seventeen-Arch Bridge final 十七孔桥终极题 (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 5 riddle-stand + 4 fork + 1 final = 10. Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Lantern riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'). Stems are deduped against all L1–L3 banks (all grades).

questions.q_en: The Seventeen-Arch Bridge has 5 lantern poles near the end, each with 2 lanterns. How many lanterns hang there?
questions.q_zh: 十七孔桥头有 5 根灯杆，每根挂 2 个灯笼，一共挂了多少个？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the bridge, 27 glow sticks are shared equally by 3 friends. How many does each friend get?
questions.q_zh: 在桥上，27 根荧光棒平均分给 3 个朋友，每人几根？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Near the bridge, Flora buys 4 lanterns at 9 yuan each and pays with 50 yuan. How much change does she get?
questions.q_zh: 在桥边，Flora 买了 4 个灯笼，每个 9 元，付了 50 元，应找回多少元？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: The lantern show at the bridge starts at 4:05 and ends at 4:30. How many minutes does it last?
questions.q_zh: 桥上的灯会表演 4:05 开始，4:30 结束，一共多少分钟？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: The Long Corridor paintings tour had 682 visitors today. Round 682 to the nearest ten.
questions.q_zh: 今天长廊彩画参观有 682 人，把 682 四舍五入到十位。
questions.explain_en: 682 rounded to the nearest ten is 680.
questions.explain_zh: 682 四舍五入到十位是 680。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Flora sees 5 pentagon-shaped lantern frames on the bridge. How many sides do they have altogether?
questions.q_zh: Flora 在桥上看见 5 个五边形的灯笼框，它们一共有几条边？
